PF2E-D20.Title: PF2e d20 Session Tracker
PF2E-D20.Settings.Timezone.Name: World timezone
PF2E-D20.Settings.Timezone.Hint: IANA timezone used to group rolls into evenings, e.g. America/Chicago. Every client buckets identically.
PF2E-D20.Settings.BoundaryHour.Name: Evening boundary hour
PF2E-D20.Settings.BoundaryHour.Hint: Rolls before this hour (world timezone) belong to the previous evening. Default 6 = a game running past midnight stays one session.
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureEnabled.Name: Capture rolls
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureEnabled.Hint: Turn off while prepping or testing between sessions so stray rolls are not recorded.
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureRawRolls.Name: Count raw d20 rolls
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureRawRolls.Hint: Include /r 1d20 style rolls and Dice Tray rolls that carry no PF2e check context.
PF2E-D20.Settings.MinRollsToList.Name: Minimum rolls to list an evening
PF2E-D20.Settings.MinRollsToList.Hint: Evenings with fewer rolls are hidden from the session picker unless 'show all' is chosen.
PF2E-D20.Settings.PlayerAccess.Name: Player access
PF2E-D20.Settings.PlayerAccess.Hint: What players may open. Secret rolls are always filtered per the blind roll policy.
PF2E-D20.Settings.BlindPolicy.Name: Blind and secret rolls in player views
PF2E-D20.Settings.BlindPolicy.Hint: Hide for the running session (default): a secret Stealth natural cannot be inferred until the session is over.
PF2E-D20.Settings.McIterations.Name: Simulated evenings
PF2E-D20.Settings.McIterations.Hint: Number of simulated fair evenings behind the 'one in N nights' labels on the fun tab.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.NoRolls: No d20 rolls recorded for this evening yet.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.RollsHint: Every physical d20 counted for this player, including both dice of fortune, misfortune and rerolls unless 'kept dice only' is on.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.AverageHint: Average natural roll. A fair die averages 10.5; the small number is the difference.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.HighHint: Share of rolls that came up 11 or higher. A fair die gives 50%.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.NatHint: How many, and what share of all rolls. A fair die gives 5%.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.LuckHint: How this evening compares with a fair die: the share of fair evenings, with the same number of rolls, that would have rolled worse. 50% is dead average, 90% is a great night, 10% a rough one.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.LuckTitle: Luckier than {pct}% of fair evenings with this many rolls (z-score {z}).
PF2E-D20.Tonight.ThinSample: Fewer than 15 rolls: treat this as a rough guess.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.NoSample: Fewer than 5 rolls: not enough to say anything.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.Help: Luck looks at the natural die only, never at modifiers or DCs. 50% is an average night; most nights land between 15% and 85% by chance alone. Expand a row for the full 1–20 breakdown and the statistics behind the percentage. This measures the dice, not the player.
PF2E-D20.Source.Preview: Preview mode: computed from the chat log on this client (nothing stored yet).
PF2E-D20.Sessions.ToggleExclude: Exclude from / include in the lists
PF2E-D20.Sessions.DeleteConfirm: Delete every recorded roll for {label}? The chat log is not touched; only the running session can be re-caught from chat.
PF2E-D20.Sessions.ResetConfirm1: Delete the whole d20 Session Log journal and every recorded evening?
PF2E-D20.Sessions.ResetConfirm2: This cannot be undone. Past evenings cannot be rebuilt from chat in this version. Really delete everything?
PF2E-D20.Sessions.CatchUpHint: Scan recent chat messages for rolls the live capture missed (after a reload or a server restart).
PF2E-D20.Fun.PAtLeast: chance of this many or more: {p}
PF2E-D20.Fun.PAtMost: chance of this few or fewer: {p}
PF2E-D20.Fun.ChiSquareNA: too few rolls for a shape test (needs 20)
PF2E-D20.Fun.Help: Everything is measured against a fair d20: this is the dice, not the players. With five players and eight awards, someone lands a 'one in twenty' most nights by chance alone. * = fewer than 15 rolls.
PF2E-D20.Fun.McNote: Rarity labels come from {iterations} simulated fair evenings with the same number of rolls.
PF2E-D20.Awards.blessed.Title: Blessed
PF2E-D20.Awards.blessed.Text: {who} ran hottest: luckier than {pct}% of evenings over {n} rolls.
PF2E-D20.Awards.cursed.Title: Cursed
PF2E-D20.Awards.cursed.Text: {who} ran coldest: luckier than only {pct}% of evenings over {n} rolls.
PF2E-D20.Awards.grinder.Title: The Grinder
PF2E-D20.Awards.consistent.Title: Consistent
PF2E-D20.Awards.consistent.Text: {who} had the steadiest rolls of the night.
PF2E-D20.Awards.chaotic.Title: Chaotic
PF2E-D20.Awards.chaotic.Text: {who} swung the most between highs and lows.
PF2E-D20.Awards.snakeEyes.Title: Snake Eyes
PF2E-D20.Awards.golden.Title: Golden
PF2E-D20.Awards.comeback.Title: Comeback
PF2E-D20.Awards.comeback.Text: {who} made the biggest hero-point turnaround: +{value} on the die.
PF2E-D20.Awards.partyMood.Title: Party mood
PF2E-D20.Awards.partyMood.Text: The table as a whole was {band}: luckier than {pct}% of evenings.
PF2E-D20.Report.Title: d20 report
PF2E-D20.Report.OpenHint: Open this evening's report in its own window (only on your screen)
PF2E-D20.Report.ShareHint: Posts one line with an Open button. The report itself never goes into the chat log.
PF2E-D20.Report.LinkText: The d20 report for {label} is ready.
PF2E-D20.Report.Foot: Natural d20s only, compared with a fair die.
PF2E-D20.History.Help: Luck percentage per evening and all time (50% is average). Evenings marked excluded on the Sessions tab are left out. Hover any number for the z-score behind it.
PF2E-D20.Export.AllHint: Download every evening you can see as one CSV file.
PF2E-D20.Settings.SessionMode.Name: How sessions are defined
PF2E-D20.Settings.SessionMode.Hint: By day: one session per day with a turnover hour. By pause: a new session starts after a number of idle hours, whatever the clock says. Start / End: the GM marks sessions by hand. Also available on the tracker's Sessions tab, with a preview.
PF2E-D20.Settings.SessionGapHours.Name: Idle hours that end a session
PF2E-D20.Settings.SessionGapHours.Hint: By pause: a roll after this many hours without any roll starts a new session. Start / End: a session left running closes itself after this long.
PF2E-D20.Access.Label: Players see
PF2E-D20.Access.Hint: What players may open. Takes effect immediately: their tracker button appears or disappears without a reload. Secret rolls stay hidden from players either way.
PF2E-D20.Definition.Title: Session definition
PF2E-D20.Definition.UsualStartHint: Sets the turnover hour 12 hours away from your usual start, where a game is least likely to be running.
PF2E-D20.Definition.Gap: idle hours that end a session
PF2E-D20.Definition.BadTimezone: "{tz}" is not a timezone this browser knows. Use an IANA name such as America/Chicago or Europe/London.
PF2E-D20.Definition.PreviewDaily: The day turns over at {boundary} ({tz}). A roll at {time} in the small hours still counts toward the previous day's session. A game that runs across {boundary} would be split in two: move the turnover, or define sessions by pause instead.
PF2E-D20.Definition.PreviewDailyMidnight: Sessions follow the calendar date ({tz}). A game that runs past midnight is split in two: raise the turnover hour, or define sessions by pause instead.
PF2E-D20.Definition.PreviewGap: A session is one run of play. A new session starts only after {hours} hours without a roll, so any timeslot works and crossing midnight never splits a game. Two games on the same date become two sessions.
PF2E-D20.Definition.PreviewManual: Sessions run from Start to End (buttons at the top of this window). Rolls made outside a session are kept aside as unscheduled. A session left running closes itself after {hours} idle hours.
PF2E-D20.Definition.RebucketHint: Regroup every stored roll under the current definition. You see exactly what would change before anything is written.
PF2E-D20.Definition.RebucketNothing: Stored history already matches this definition. Nothing to move.
PF2E-D20.Definition.RebucketConfirm: {moved} rolls would move to a different session ({created} sessions created, {removed} removed).
PF2E-D20.Definition.RebucketNote: Names and exclusions are kept where a session survives. Sessions merged or split by hand are regrouped by the rule. No roll is ever deleted.
PF2E-D20.Definition.StartHint: Rolls from now on belong to a new session until you press End.
PF2E-D20.Definition.EndHint: Close the running session. Later rolls are kept aside as unscheduled until the next Start.
PF2E-D20.Sessions.UnscheduledHint: rolled outside any session; not counted anywhere until assigned
PF2E-D20.Sessions.MergeConfirm: Move every roll of {from} into {into} and remove {from}?
PF2E-D20.Sessions.SplitHint: Split {label} at one of its longest pauses. Rolls after the pause become a new session.
PF2E-D20.Sessions.SplitNone: This session has no pause long enough to split at.
PF2E-D20.Sessions.AssignHint: Move all unscheduled rolls into this session:
PF2E-D20.Sessions.DiscardConfirm: Delete every unscheduled roll? This cannot be undone.
